IBM Quantum Falcon r5.11

IBM · superconducting circuits · RETIRED (in service 2019-2023) · 27 physical qubits · access: cloud (historical)
architecture: סריג טרנסמונים עם מצמדים ברי-כוונון · Open on the map

Register profile — the machine's variant of its architecture

qubit type: fixed-frequency transmon
gate mechanism: fixed capacitive bus, CR/CX
connectivity: heavy-hex
control: room-temperature RF, coax per qubit
control placement: room-temp
readout: multiplexed dispersive
codes: heavy_hex, honeycomb_floquet, stab_4_2_2

טרנסמון · primary ▣ Fig. 4 (Falcon qubit numbering, static ZZ); Methods: IBM_Peekskill and experimental details ✅
fixed-frequency transmon; 27 q monolithic (r5.11, ibm_peekskill; DEPLOYED 2019–2023, now RETIRED)

תת-מרחב דו-רמתי חשוף · primary ▣ Fig. 5 (leakage to |2⟩); Methods: Leakage in the system ✅

heavy-hex, degree 3 max / 2.3 mean (2022)
5 בקרה
אלקטרוניקה בטמפרטורת החדר + קואקס/כבל גמיש לכל קיוביט · primary ▤ 🔎

6 קריאה
קריאה דיספרסיבית במיקרוגל (+TWPA, מסנן פרסל) · primary ▣ Fig. 5a (repeated measurement sequence); Methods: Leakage in the system ✅
multiplexed dispersive
7 קוד
קודים לגילוי שגיאות ([[4,2,2]], קוד משטח d = 2, מרחב-זמן) · primary ▤ Nature 625, 259 (2024), main text and Methods ✅
[[4,2,2]] error-detecting code: magic state encoded with detection and post-selection on ibm_peekskill (27-q Falcon); logical infidelity (1.23±0.11)×10⁻² post-selected vs best physical two-qubit magic state (2.354±0.271)×10⁻² — beyond break-even
קוד המשטח המסובב (+ גרסאות yoked) · alternate ▣ Fig. 1 (heavy-hexagon code gauge operators) ✅
nearest technology to heavy_hex subsystem code (d=2 2017, d=3 2022–23); also stab_4_2_2 flag-FT state prep, honeycomb_floquet plaquette measurement
8 מפענח
MWPM / Sparse Blossom (+התאמה מתואמת) · primary ▣ Fig. 6 (four decoding methods); Methods: MWPM edge probabilities; Maximum likelihood ✅
matching and maximum-likelihood decoding of the heavy-hex code, offline
— none — nothing in this layer ▤ §Results: Decoding algorithms ✅
offline decoding only; no real-time decoder in the loop

monolithic single 27-q module, no interconnect
